program='''def transform(grid):
    by_diagonal = {}
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        for c, value in enumerate(row):
            if value != 0:
                offset = c - r
                by_diagonal[offset] = value

    colors = set(by_diagonal.values())
    if len(colors) == 1:
        value = next(iter(colors))
        return [[value for _ in row] for row in grid]

    period = len(by_diagonal)
    pattern = {offset % period: value for offset, value in by_diagonal.items()}
    return [[pattern[(c - r) % period] for c in range(len(row))]
            for r, row in enumerate(grid)]
'''
